meta.name: Classical · parameterized alphabet
meta.metric: Parameterized in q, R and τ
meta.regime: Fix q, R=k/n, τ=t/n and bit-vs-field-operation model
meta.rules: Binary coefficients cannot be transferred to q≥3. Instantiate alphabet q, code rate and relative weight before assigning a scalar exponent. See Hirose2016 and Elbro–Santini2025; the latter distinguishes memory-less and meet-in-the-middle algorithms.
